notes.title: DECEMBER UPDATE NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Great news, 

The Super Dungeon Bros mega update is now live! Also, we have now added compatibility for Mac - anyone who has downloaded on Steam will also be download the Mac version from today!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25224284/c3e09109a6118ce2e46aab734be22c09996e705c.jpg[/img]

This features a number of major updates, from online multiplayer to overall usability and in-game functionality improvements, including;

[list]
[*][b]Online Multiplayer[/b] – Bros and Broettes can now rock out with 2, 3 or 4 other players in On and Offline Co-Op Multiplayer with Private Lobbies also now available.
[*][b]Improved Game Functionality[/b] – Significantly reduced load times, Single Player and Multiplayer revive functions now match each other, missions related to achievements have been corrected and characters now include an outline when behind set objects (pillars etc) plus much more.
[*][b]Weapons Stability[/b] – Increased mobility and improved re-load times for ranged weapons as well as fixes for specific issues related to various weapons HP.
[*][b]Multiple UI Enhancements[/b] – Various UI enhancements have now been implemented including an on-going score count, improved contextual prompts for the threat meter and weapon upgrades.
[*][b]General Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b] – A host of general bug fixes and improvements, including significantly reduced loading times as well a considerable reduction in frame rate issues encountered by some users.
[/list]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]NEW[/b]
Bogheim now available in Online Multiplayer

[b]NEW[/b]
Chillheim now available in Online Multiplayer

[b]NEW[/b]
Outline of character now available when behind an object (i.e. Pillar, Chains etc)

[b]NEW [/b]
Bogheim Boss will be playable online

[b]NEW[/b]
A more descriptive tutorial prompt for Ultimate Attacks is now available

[b]NEW[/b]
Private Lobbies now available for 2 & 3 player Online Multiplayer 

[b]BUG [/b]
Depth 4 Mini Boss escapes room in Chillheim

[b]BUG  [/b]
Fixed frame rate drops when lots of enemies spawn

[b]BUG [/b] 
Fixed Spookem spawning when players jump on a corner column. 

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed Glass Cannon, which emptied half the health bar when it halves health

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed Tide Caller upgrade description, which was wrong

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed Missions that don’t work in relation to the 'Trifecta' Achievement.

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed where players can fall and get stuck when in battle with Bogheim Mini Boss 

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed the Relentless Cleaver only had 300 HP

[b]BUG [/b] 
Fixed when playing Online Multiplayer, if additional players quit on host console, game would freeze

[b]BUG[/b] 
Fixed text on the Records Saved screen was incorrectly sized

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed error message displayed after accepting an invitation to an Online Multiplayer session 

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed a bug where under certain circumstances, matching online was breaking when there was more than one user per console

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed several in-game features that would not function when accepting a Multiplayer invite if playing a single player session

[b]BUG[/b]  
Fixed bug where players could spawn off map when playing in Cryptheim.

[b]BUG[/b]
Fixed loading times which have been significantly reduced.

[b]BUG[/b]
Fixed issue when coins earner would go into negative number instead of gain, or vice versa

[b]BUG[/b]
Fixed the Bogheim record award screen

[b]BUG[/b]
Fixed 'Relentless Cleaver' HP discrepancy

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Added running score total in-game

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Changed the Revive function in Single player to match Multiplayer

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Crossbows have been tuned to be more inline with the other weapons allowing for mobility while still dishing out damage. Reloading is now faster for all crossbows.

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Multiple UI enhancements to improve the player experience

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Players will be able to drop from the Equip Screen without ending the game for everyone else

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Added contextual prompts in the first depth to replace the tutorial

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Redesigned Shrine room to be more descriptive for players

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Added contextual prompts and brief descriptions to better define elements such as the Threat Meter, Shards, Weapon Upgrades, etc

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Made in-game text more concise

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Adjusted Threat Meter behavior so it pauses when all players are dead

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Threat Meter no longer increases in Depth 1 until the user gets past the Shrine Room

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Adjusted Threat Meter behavior so it pauses when all players are dead

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Removed Dizzy element from Dodge Roll. Players are now able to Dodge Roll with a slight delay between each Dodge instead.

[b]IMPROVEMENT[/b]
Added running score total in-game

http://www.superdungeonbros.com/news/bros-update-rolling-out-on-ps4-and-steam

notes.title: Super Dungeon Bros Update
notes.notes:
S'up Bros!

Thank you for all your feedback and support since we launched November 1st! We're pleased to announce that we are rolling out an update that will see significant improvements to Super Dungeon Bros! Landing today the update adds the much requested ability to play online with just two or three players, as well as improved loading times (about half of what they were!). We also listened to feedback around the Pain Hailer, decreasing reload time, increasing movement speed whilst charging and increasing ammo capacity! There are general game-play fixes on issues raised by the community too.


[h1]Issue resolved[/h1]

[b]Purchased soundtracks not installing[/b]
[b]Spawn off map - Cryptheim[/b]
[b]Achievement "Well Rounded" broken[/b]
[b]Tweak Pain Hailer crossbow[/b]
[b]Allow for 2 & 3 player online sessions[/b]
[b]Improve Load Times	[/b]
[b]Online MP - Cryptheim puzzle room has a blocker[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25224284/c7cd1694018fa254293456bed9343faf8ff46415.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update incoming!
notes.notes:
Hi Bros,

I'm pleased to announce an incoming [b]update[/b] to Super Dungeon Bros, following the community’s feedback and requests.

The update, landing later this week, will change MP, allowing for 2, 3 or 4 player co-op (currently only 4 player or nothing is possible) as well as significantly reducing load time - by nearly 50%!

We've also made several fixes to issues the community identified and increased the stability. This includes fixes where Album packs were not downloading, achievement issues and fixes around the crossbow.

Stay tuned for more information and if you want a game online, let us know!

Neil - Community Manager
